summary: Assistance with safely unpinning tenant optimization profiles, KV cache reset, and controlled quant downgrade
description:
Issue summary: Customer reports sustained 95p tail latency increase after recent per-tenant optimizer pinning. Customer requests guidance to safely unpin optimization profiles, perform a controlled KV cache reset (if required), and optionally downgrade quant profiles without causing widespread throughput degradation.
Impact: LexaHealth reported 20-40% increase in p95 across API routes serving clinical summarization workloads; errors observed intermittently but primarily timeouts and elevated queueing. This is a paying dedicated customer with provisioned GPU pools.
Environment: Redwood Dedicated pool (dedicated tenant), prod us-east-1, model variants gpt-large-v2 (fp16) and gpt-legacy-quant (4-bit).
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Send standard clinical summarize requests (token length 800-1,200) to tenant endpoint with tenant optimizer profile pinned.
2) Observe increased p95 and queue depth in serving-runtime dashboard for tenant_id=lexa-01.
3) Confirm config-store shows per-tenant 'pin_profile' flag set and quant profile 'aggressive-4bit' active on gpt-legacy-quant.
4) Attempt light traffic replay in staging yields lower latency, indicating problem is operational with prod-specific config and cache state.
logs: 2026-03-09T17:33:10Z scheduler autoscale decision: no additional nodes available for dedicated pool lexapool-3
investigation_notes: Support validated that pinning increases kernel specialization; that specialization appears to reduce multi-tenant eviction fairness under mixed sequence length workloads.
KV cache occupancy for lexapool-3 is >92% and TTL churn is high for large prompts—observed in kv-monitor dashboard: https://grafana.company/d/kv/leak?var-tenant=lexa-01
Quant profile 'aggressive-4bit' increases per-token compute variance for longer sequences; fallback variant gpt-large-v2 (fp16) shows lower p95 under controlled tests.
No hardware faults found; GPU utilization is healthy but request queuing indicates scheduling contention at the runtime layer.
resolution_plan: Goal: Unpin optimization profile with minimum customer-visible regression and safe rollback path.
1) Snapshot current tenant optimizer state (config-store snapshot + KV cache size metric). Save snapshot id: snap-lexa-20260310-01.
2) Create a traffic-shadow route (10% shadow) to an unpinned profile on a small subset of internal test traffic for 30 minutes to validate latency behavior.
3) If shadow p95 remains within 10% of baseline, schedule an incremental unpin: toggle 'pin_profile=false' for tenant lex-01 during a low-traffic window and monitor for 15 minutes.
4) After unpin, do not immediately flush global KV cache. Instead run per-tenant KV soft-evict: reduce TTL on tenant prefixes to accelerate natural eviction and avoid cold-start bursts.
5) If tail latency worsens >15% after unpin, automatic rollback steps: reapply the snapshot, re-pin profile using snap-lexa-20260310-01 (config-store restore) and revert TTL changes.

6) For quant downgrade: apply staged downgrade matrix — first reduce quant aggressiveness (aggressive-4bit -> conservative-4bit -> fp16) using progressive routing (traffic splitting 80/20 -> 50/50 -> 100/0) with per-step 10 minute monitoring windows.
7) Escalation: if autoscaling cannot meet increased throughput after unpin, open INT ticket for capacity add (INT-330) and consider temporary traffic shaping.
workaround: If immediate relief required: enable tenant-specific throttling (route limit 50rps) and pin fallback to fp16 variant (gpt-large-v2) while we perform the safe unpin procedure. This reduces p95 spikes at the cost of throughput.
follow_up_actions: Document a per-tenant unpin checklist in Confluence and add to runbook library.
Add an automated snapshot step to optimizer pin change APIs so future unpins are atomic and reversible.
Investigate improving KV cache eviction policy for long prompt tenants (follow-on ENG ticket).
resolution_notes: Pending: shadow validation completed (03/11) with 8% p95 delta, incremental unpin scheduled 03/12 02:00 UTC. Monitoring hooks and rollback automation prepared.
